0:
mkdir -p /data/snapshots
export BAO_TOKEN=$(bao write -format=json auth/utility/login role=openbao-snapshots jwt="$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token)" | awk -F'"' '/client_token/{print $4}')
bao operator raft snapshot save /data/snapshots/openbao-raft.snap
ls -l /data/snapshots

until [ -f /data/snapshots/openbao-raft.snap ]; do sleep 5; done
gcloud auth activate-service-account --key-file=/data/credentials/credentials.json
gsutil cp /data/snapshots/openbao-raft.snap gs://$BUCKET_NAME/openbao_raft_$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S").snap

cp /config/cookies.txt /config/cookies-rw.txt
ytdl-sub --log-level=debug --config=/config/config.yaml sub /media/youtube/subscriptions.yaml
echo "[cronjob:command] Fixing permissions, started at $$(date --rfc-2822)"
find $${MEDIA_FOLDER} -user root -exec chown 568:568 "{}" \; -exec chmod 777 "{}" \;
echo "[cronjob:command] Fixed permissions, ended at $$(date --rfc-2822)"

ops=(
  "db:add-missing-primary-keys"
  "db:add-missing-indices"
  "db:add-missing-columns"
  "files:cleanup"
)
grey="\e[1;30m"
reset="\e[0m"
green="\e[1;32m"
red="\e[1;31m"
for op in "$${ops[@]}" ; do
  echo -e "$${grey}Running php occ $op $reset"
  su www-data -s /usr/local/bin/php -- occ $op && echo -en "$green" || echo -en "$red"
  echo -e "Finished php occ $op $reset"
done &&
echo -e "$${grey}Running php occ maintenance:repair --include-expensive $reset"
su www-data -s /usr/local/bin/php -- occ maintenance:repair --include-expensive && echo -en "$green" || echo -en "$red"
echo -e "Finished php occ maintenance:repair --include-expensive $reset"
while :; do /cron.sh; done

chmod +x /var/www/html/custom_apps/notify_push/bin/x86_64/notify_push && \
while :; do su www-data \
  -s /var/www/html/custom_apps/notify_push/bin/x86_64/notify_push -- \
  /var/www/html/config/config.php; sleep 1; done &
pid=$!
grey="\e[1;30m"
reset="\e[0m"
green="\e[1;32m"
red="\e[1;31m"
echo -e "$${grey}Waiting a few seconds for services to start$${reset}"
sleep 10
echo -e "$${grey}Testing if push app is configured"
op="notify_push:setup https://${social_domain}/push"
while ! su www-data -s /usr/local/bin/php -- occ "notify_push:self-test"; do
  echo -e "$${grey}Self-test failed, running php occ $op $reset"
  if ! su www-data -s /usr/local/bin/php -- occ $op; then
    echo -e "$${red}$${op} operation failed, retrying...$${reset}"
    sleep 5
  fi
done
echo -e "$${green}Test passed$${reset}"
wait $pid

while true; do
  rm -rf /tmp/chrome
  chromium-browser --headless --remote-debugging-port=9222 --user-data-dir=/tmp/chrome
  sleep 1
done

set -eu
mc alias set local http://minio:9000 "$MINIO_ROOT_USER" "$MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD"
mc mb --ignore-existing local/dossier
# s3:ListBucket is not for listing: the app's boot-time
# BucketExists probe is a HeadBucket, which minio authorizes as
# s3:ListBucket. Without it the app fails to start.
cat > /tmp/dossier-rw.json <<'JSON'
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:GetBucketLocation", "s3:ListBucket"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::dossier"]
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "s3:GetObject",
        "s3:PutObject",
        "s3:DeleteObject",
        "s3:AbortMultipartUpload",
        "s3:ListMultipartUploadParts"
      ],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::dossier/*"]
    }
  ]
}
JSON
mc admin policy create local dossier-rw /tmp/dossier-rw.json
mc admin user add local "$VEROSO_S3_ACCESS_KEY" "$VEROSO_S3_SECRET_KEY"
# attach is not idempotent: it errors once the policy is on the user
mc admin user info local "$VEROSO_S3_ACCESS_KEY" | grep -q dossier-rw ||
  mc admin policy attach local dossier-rw --user "$VEROSO_S3_ACCESS_KEY"

[[runners]]
  [runners.kubernetes]
    helper_image = "ghcr.io/vaskozl/gitlab-runner-helper:latest"
    pull_policy = ["always", "if-not-present"]
    cpu_request = "500m"
    cpu_limit = "1"
    memory_request = "256Mi"
    memory_limit = "8Gi"
    service_cpu_request = "100m"
    service_cpu_limit = "1"
    service_memory_request = "50Mi"
    service_memory_limit = "1Gi"
    helper_cpu_request = "5m"
    helper_cpu_limit = "500m"
    helper_memory_request = "50Mi"
    helper_memory_limit = "200Mi"
    poll_interval = 5
    poll_timeout = 600
    # Used by bubblewrap
    cap_add = ["NET_ADMIN", "SYS_ADMIN"]
    [[runners.kubernetes.volumes.empty_dir]]
      name = "docker-emptydir"
      mount_path = "/var/run"
      medium = "Memory"
    [[runners.kubernetes.volumes.pvc]]
      name = "apk-repo-pvc"
      mount_path = "/apks"
    [runners.kubernetes.node_selector]
      "kubernetes.io/arch" = "amd64"
